components.name: Active Connect Button
components.description: The primary readiness and connection action.

components.description: A low-emphasis toolbar action that becomes tonal on hover.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { height: 36px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 500 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375)); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815 / 0.28)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workbench Panel
components.description: The flat bordered container for one operational responsibility.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; min-height: 180px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-card-foreground, oklch(0.48 0.014 285.938)); box-shadow: none; } .ds-panel-header { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 700 12px/16px "Geist Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-panel-body { display: grid; min-height: 136px; place-items: center; padding: 16px; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }

components.name: Segmented Call Workbench Tabs
components.description: A compact switch between call workbench views. Tenant administration instead uses a two-row header: tenant context and account actions, then underlined destination links and page actions. See DESIGN.md Navigation.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-muted, oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375)); } .ds-tab { height: 33px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 700 12px/16px "Geist Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.48 0.014 285.938)) 10%, transparent); } .ds-tab.is-active { background: var(--color-background, oklch(1 0 0)); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815 / 0.28)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Field
components.description: A compact filter field for dense event and data regions.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-secondary, oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375)); color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.48 0.014 285.938)); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-filter:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-ring, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus, oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815 / 0.28)); } .ds-filter input { width: 150px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 400 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-filter input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.48 0.014 285.938)); } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Status Readout
components.description: A compact label-and-value block for live system state.
components.css: .ds-status { border: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-card-foreground, oklch(0.48 0.014 285.938)); } .ds-status h3 { margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px 4px; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 700 12px/16px "Geist Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-status dl { margin: 0; padding: 4px 12px 10px; } .ds-status dl div { display: flex; min-height: 28px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-status dt { font: 400 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-status dd { margin: 0; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 400 12px/18px "Geist Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; }

components.css: .ds-status-rail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 1.25fr) repeat(2, minmax(120px, 1fr)); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-divider-strong, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-charcoal, oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885)); color: var(--color-paper, oklch(0.985 0 0)); } .ds-status-primary { display: flex; min-height: 64px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-status-primary strong, .ds-status-primary small { display: block; } .ds-status-primary strong { font: 700 16px/24px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-status-primary small { color: var(--color-divider-strong, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)); font: 400 12px/18px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-status-marker { width: 10px; height: 10px; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 2px solid var(--color-charcoal, oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885)); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-green, oklch(0.51 0.13 162.48)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-green-soft, oklch(0.95 0.055 162.48)); } .ds-status-value { min-height: 64px; padding: 12px 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-worktop, oklch(0.274 0.006 286.033)); } .ds-status-value span, .ds-status-value strong { display: block; font-family: "Geist Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; } .ds-status-value span { color: var(--color-divider-strong, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.055em; } .ds-status-value strong { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Data Matrix
components.description: A compact divided table whose selected row stays subordinate to operational state.
components.css: .ds-matrix { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid var(--color-divider-strong, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)); background: var(--color-canvas, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-muted, oklch(0.48 0.014 285.938)); font: 400 14px/17.5px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-matrix th, .ds-matrix td { padding: 8px 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-divider, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-divider, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); text-align: left; } .ds-matrix th { background: var(--color-paper, oklch(0.985 0 0)); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 700 12px/16px "Geist Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0.055em; } .ds-matrix th:last-child, .ds-matrix td:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-matrix tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-matrix tbody tr:hover { background: var(--color-panel, oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375)); } .ds-matrix .ds-matrix-selected, .ds-matrix .ds-matrix-selected:hover { background: var(--color-selection, oklch(0.96 0.025 259.815)); } .ds-matrix a { color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font: 650 14px/17.5px "Geist Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-matrix a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, oklch(0.623 0.214 259.815 / 0.28)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-matrix-state { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)); font-family: "Geist Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-matrix-state i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-green, oklch(0.51 0.13 162.48)); }

narrative.overview:
The Operator's Bench treats each screen as a working instrument: technical, calm, and dependable. The interface is compact and information-dense without feeling hurried; hierarchy comes from alignment, mono labels, borders, and restrained semantic color rather than decorative emphasis.

Surfaces stay quiet so state is unmistakable. Neutral panels form a stable frame; Signal Green marks readiness and action, Fault Coral marks unavailable or error states, and identity hues remain tied to agent and client roles. Controls feel instrument-like and state-explicit.
keyCharacteristics: Dual light and dark neutral work surfaces
Sans-serif actions paired with uppercase mono labels and readouts
Saturated color reserved for state and identity
Flat, bordered panels with shallow corners

rules.name: The State Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated hues are reserved for operational state and participant identity; neutral structure carries everything else.

rules.name: The Theme Is a Remap Rule
rules.body: Light and dark modes preserve hierarchy and semantic assignments rather than merely inverting pixels.

rules.name: The Quiet Canvas Rule
rules.body: Do not add decorative gradients or brand color washes to operational surfaces.

rules.name: The Readout Split Rule
rules.body: Use sans-serif type for prose and actions; use mono for terse labels, identifiers, status values, and timestamps.

rules.name: The One Working Surface Rule
rules.body: Group related tools inside one bordered panel; do not create decorative cards inside cards.

rules.name: The Container Owns Overflow Rule
rules.body: Wide matrices and raw readouts contain their own overflow; responsive pages never create page-level horizontal scroll.

rules.name: The Flat at Rest Rule
rules.body: Core work surfaces never float; one-pixel dividers and tonal contrast define hierarchy. Shadows belong only to temporary overlays.

rules.name: The Tool, Not Toy Rule
rules.body: Keep corners shallow and functional; do not turn ordinary content, labels, or panels into pills.

rules.name: The One State, One Signal Rule
rules.body: A control's color, label, icon, and disabled treatment must agree about its operational state.

dos: Do build hierarchy from panels, alignment, tonal layers, and dividers.
Do keep status colors tied to readiness, failure, agent, and client roles.
Do use uppercase mono labels for terse categories and sans-serif type for readable instructions and actions.
Do preserve the evidenced responsive model for each operator surface: the realtime workspace changes mode at 640px, while data workbenches reflow by 760px.
Do keep selected rows quiet enough that live, ended, and failed markers remain the strongest operational signals.
Do bring new custom surfaces onto these tokens before treating them as design authority.
donts: Don't use unstyled browser-default controls or the former Room lifecycle slice bar as design-system evidence.
Don't soften the console into consumer chat styling with plush message bubbles, oversized pills, or friendly gradient cards.
Don't import decorative marketing treatments such as hero-scale type, ornamental glows, or gradient backdrops into operational screens.
Don't nest decorative cards inside working panels.
Don't use saturated color as ornament; every bright hue must communicate a defined state or identity.
Don't solve narrow layouts with page-level horizontal scrolling; contain raw data locally and reflow or remove secondary fields.
